controles.affirmation: Titre : '935 M$ provisionnes pour des donnees Medicare mal soumises, sur onze ans d'historique'
controles.verbatim_source: certain Medicare Advantage risk adjustment data submission requirements related to diagnosis codes for dates of service 2015 through April 2023 (soit environ huit ans et quatre mois)
controles.correction_proposee: 'sur plus de huit ans d'historique (soins de 2015 a avril 2023)'. Le corps de l'argument dit d'ailleurs 'soit huit annees de dossiers' : le titre contredit son propre texte.

controles.affirmation: Provision CMS de 935 M$ au 31 mars 2026, 342 M$ payes le 27 mai 2026, 593 M$ restants au 30 juin 2026, fourchette +/- 320 M$
controles.verbatim_source: the Company recorded an accrual in connection with the CMS Notice of approximately $935 at March 31, 2026 ... On May 27, 2026 we paid CMS $342, leaving an accrual balance of $593 as of June 30, 2026 ... could range from approximately $320 less than the amount originally accrued up to $320 in excess of the amount originally accrued

controles.affirmation: Le 13 juillet 2026, CMS a confirme la cloture de la procedure d'execution sans sanction
controles.verbatim_source: On July 13, 2026, the Company received a letter from CMS stating that the Company has completed all required steps, sanctions will not be imposed and the enforcement process for this matter has been closed.

controles.affirmation: Poursuite civile du DOJ depuis mars 2020 au titre du False Claims Act ; instruction des faits jusqu'au 31 aout 2026 et des expertises jusqu'au 10 mai 2027
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2020, the U.S. Department of Justice ("DOJ") filed a civil lawsuit against Elevance Health, Inc. ... alleges ... that we falsely certified the accuracy of the diagnosis data ... and knowingly failed to delete inaccurate diagnosis codes ... in violation of the False Claims Act ... Fact and expert discovery are ongoing with current completion deadlines of August 31, 2026 and May 10, 2027, respectively.

controles.affirmation: CMS a annonce en mai 2025 l'intensification des audits RADV et a commence a les mettre en oeuvre
controles.verbatim_source: in May 2025, CMS announced plans to substantially increase the scale and pace of Risk Adjustment Data Validation ("RADV") audits of Medicare Advantage plans. CMS has initiated these RADV audit changes

controles.affirmation: Reforme PBM de la Consolidated Appropriations Act de fevrier 2026 (reversement integral sous 30 mois, delinkage Part D en 2028)
controles.verbatim_source: In February 2026, Congress passed the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026, which includes pharmacy benefit manager reforms requiring pharmacy benefit managers to remit all rebates, fees ... effective 30 months after enactment. The legislation also ... delinks pharmacy benefit manager compensation in Medicare Part D ... effective in 2028.

controles.affirmation: CarelonRx delegue ses fonctions coeur a CaremarkPCS Health (CVS) jusqu'au 31 decembre 2027, avec option d'extension de trois ans
controles.verbatim_source: CarelonRx delegates certain core pharmacy services to CaremarkPCS Health, L.L.C. ... pursuant to an agreement (the "CVS Agreement") with the current contractual term extending through December 31, 2027. We can elect to have CVS continue to provide services to us for a three-year extension period on the same terms and conditions

controles.affirmation: Expiration des APTC au 31 decembre 2025 avec impact sur les effectifs du marche individuel ; OBBBA promulguee le 4 juillet 2025
controles.verbatim_source: The APTCs expired on December 31, 2025. As a result, the cost of Public Exchange coverage premiums has increased for those individuals previously receiving the APTCs, which has impacted our Individual market enrollment. ; the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (the "OBBBA") was signed into law on July 4, 2025
